name: Raipur Cube Championship 2018

venue.name: Club Paraiso
venue.address: Club Paraiso, Maruti Lifestyle, Parmanand Nagar, Kota, Raipur, Chhattisgarh 492001

information: **Participants have to bring their own cube for the event.** On-the-spot (OTS) registration will be also be available as per the times mentioned in the [Schedule Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RaipurCubeChampionship2018#7431-schedule) for 2x2, 3x3, 3x3 One-Handed and Pyraminx. OTS will **not be** available for 4x4 and 5x5 events. The fees structure is variable as per information given in the [Registration and Payments Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RaipurCubeChampionship2018#7429-registrations-payments). Please note once you register in WCA site for the Raipur Cube Championship 2018, your name will be in waiting list and once your payment is done then your name will appear in competitors list within 1-2 days. All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except New comers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to Judge (or) Scramble for the entire event, all this will be decided by the organising team and will be informed 2 days before the event, we will make sure that your volunteering will not affect your main events and participation. ***Quick Info links:*** [**Event Schedule**](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RaipurCubeChampionship2018#7431-schedule) **[Payment Details](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RaipurCubeChampionship2018#7429-registrations-payments)**
